user.title: Add Zendure device
user.description: Devices are normally found automatically. Add one by hand only when it never shows up.

data_description.prodkey: The productKey the Zendure cloud reports for the device.
data_description.device_id: The deviceKey the Zendure cloud reports for the device.
data_description.sn: The serial number on the device label.
data_description.ip: Fixed address for the local API; learned automatically when empty.
data_description.blemac: Learned automatically from the Bluetooth advertisement when empty.

reconfigure.title: {name}
reconfigure.description: The name of a device never changes; its addresses can.

data_description.ip: Fixed address for the local API; learned automatically when empty.
data_description.blemac: Learned automatically from the Bluetooth advertisement when empty.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name; HA names the device and its entities after it.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Kind of appliance, a label only; the behaviour is the same for every kind.

latest_start_time.name: Latest start time
latest_start_time.description: Time (HH:MM) by which the cycle must have started; empty applies the default rule.

manage.name: Manage
manage.description: Off: ZenMaster never arms this appliance and never touches its switch.

power_rating.name: Power rating
power_rating.description: Power of a cycle in kW, used until a profile has been learned from history.

cycle_duration_slots.name: Cycle duration
cycle_duration_slots.description: Duration of a cycle in quarters of an hour, used until a profile has been learned.

charge_power_entity.name: Charge power setting
charge_power_entity.description: Number entity that sets the charger's power.

soc_entity.name: State of charge
soc_entity.description: Sensor with the car's state of charge in percent.

connected_entity.name: Connected
connected_entity.description: Binary sensor that tells whether the cable is connected.

departure_time.name: Departure time
departure_time.description: Time (HH:MM) by which the car must be charged.

ev_max_soc.name: Target state of charge
ev_max_soc.description: State of charge (0-1) to charge up to.

charge_compensation_eur_kwh.name: Price limit
charge_compensation_eur_kwh.description: Price per kWh under which charging pays; on solar only under a third of it.

capacity_kwh.name: Battery capacity
capacity_kwh.description: Capacity of the car battery in kWh.

max_power_kw.name: Maximum charge power
max_power_kw.description: Maximum power of the charger in kW.

derate_entity.name: Curtailment
derate_entity.description: Number entity that throttles the inverter; empty means it cannot curtail.
